overhead-reduction.summary: Base overhead and unit upkeep cost 25% less. Compute and service bills stay full price.

faster-collections.summary: New invoices wait 50% less before collection. Existing invoices keep their dates.

demand-stake-reduction.summary: Demand stakes cost 35% less. Poor-fit profiles still waste the stake.

product-fit.summary: New shipments gain 12 fit points, capped at 100. The recipe still needs your work.

care-window.summary: Resolved problems get 2 months of care. Unanswered problems still churn.

addon-service.summary: Addon service overhead costs 25% less. Base service costs stay unchanged.

context-decay.summary: Routine agent work adds 25% less context rot. Existing rot remains.

compute-reduction.summary: Agent compute costs 25% less. Coordination load still grows.

protect-threat.summary: Resolve one live customer problem and protect it for one month. No new ARR.

reset-context.summary: Clear one function’s context rot. Strain and recurring compute bills remain.
